answer_text: Yes. To reset MFA for the user: In the Cato Management Application, go to Access > Users, check the user, then from Actions choose Reset MFA and confirm. The user will receive an email with a link to the Cato User Portal; after signing in, they will need to complete MFA enrollment. If you instead need to reset MFA for an administrator, use Account > Administrators, select the admin, and choose Reset MFA.
